_about: Curated competitor claims for comparison articles. Each claim carries the exact quote it rests on and the official page it was read from; the engine re-fetches the page before every use and DROPS the claim if the quote is no longer there (research_policy: official documentation, stored URL/publisher/access date/claim; fallback: omit rather than rely on model memory). Zoom's support centre refuses non-browser fetches; the Zoom claims rest on Zoom's product pages, which serve plain HTML.
